breakdown: ⏳ Blue Jackets got the extra day: 2 days off to Hurricanes' 1 day.

📅 And the Hurricanes just took a 2-1 win over the Bruins. Both sides walk in hot.

🗑️ A 3-8 team. Kings about to get their ass beat.
📅 Senators took a 4-1 loss to the Golden Knights last time; Kings took a 2-1 loss to the Blackhawks. Two teams looking to get right.

✅ Predators are at full strength.

🟡 Bottom line: Predators (-108). Basically a coin flip - Predators by a nose. Fun to ride, not a money play.

📋 Hawks are 2-3 after a 129-117 loss to the Heat.

🟡 Bottom line: Hawks (-115). A coin flip game - if you're playing it, Hawks's the side. No units from us.

🚑 Packers are without Zaire Franklin (LB), Travis Glover (OT), Sean Rhyan (G), Micah Parsons (DE). Bodies missing over there.

🧳 Panthers go on the road and win: 2-1 away from home.
📅 Last time out: a 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers for Panthers, a 20-17 loss to the Lions for Packers. Both got something to prove.
📋 Panthers are 3-3 after a 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers.

✅ Bottom line: Panthers (+164). A half-unit shot: our read says coin flip, the dog angles say Panthers. You can't win if you don't play.
